message:
With storms brewing outside, I’ve been reminded of the simpler things in life. When the power goes out, it’s a great opportunity to rediscover low-tech fun! I’ve dusted off some board games and gathered my grandkids for a little old-fashioned competition. 

It’s funny how a little rain can lead to such laughter and connection. Who knew I had such fierce competition in Scrabble? 

What’s your go-to activity when the weather keeps you indoors?
